name: Towers of Twilight
summary:
I was hired to find the Codex of the Abyss. According to legend, the Codex is an ancient book of dark magic bound in man-skin leather. Sounds charming. Its last known location was the Valley of Sarnoth, probably in one of the old tombs scattered about the landscape. I was hoping to find some additional valuables along the way as well.

Unfortunately, I got off track in the mountains. Now I'm lost with no idea which way to go. While I was climbing down a cliff face, I fell into a fast-moving river and most of my equipment got washed away. At this point, my main concern is just to survive and get back home. But if I can still find the Codex, maybe this trip won't end up a complete waste of time.
